target_customer: Real estate agents and brokerages, and small home services businesses such as roofing and pest control
problem: Leads go unanswered or uncalled, and agents spend hours on cold calls and expired listings instead of closing.
business_model: Subscription per AI agent, 589 USD per month for the receptionist and 289 USD per month for the outbound agent, with per minute overage
product_category: Vertical AI voice agents for real estate and home services

founders.name: Aidan Richards
education: BA Political Science, George Washington University
founders.background_notes: From the YC page. Inman says he worked in residential and commercial real estate and fintech sales.

founders.name: Yevgeniy Matsay
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no education or employers.

competitors.name: Avoca
competitors.what: AI voice and operations for home services with ServiceTitan integration
competitors.traction_then: Partnerships with Nexstar Network and Clover
competitors.funding_then: 125M USD plus at a 1B USD valuation

competitors.name: Probook
competitors.what: AI operating system for home services combining voice, messaging and lead handling

competitors.name: Newo
competitors.what: AI receptionist for dental, restaurant and home services businesses

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on third party voice, speech and language model infrastructure with calendar integrations. Hard parts are latency and conversation quality, not core research.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded competitors sell the same voice agent, there is no proprietary data or lock in described, and the site pricing is month to month.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded voice AI players had raised large rounds in the preceding year. No acquisition of Rezora found.

market_need_then: Agents spend hours on cold calls and unanswered leads. The company claims it earned 40K USD in its first 40 days and a 94 percent contact rate, both self reported and unverified.

branding.domain_note: Uses rezora.io. An unrelated real estate email marketing firm called Rezora in Boulder also exists.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, benefit focused and friendly, with Never miss a call and Never miss a lead

branding.brand_signature: Shopify for AI voice agents positioning
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by Commercial Observer and Inman in 2026 and a Mixergy interview, mostly about the product.

brand_strength.rationale: Press exists but is about the product, and the name collides with an older company of the same name.

pivots.from: Outbound cold calling AI for residential real estate agents
pivots.to: Adding an inbound receptionist and home services (YC description)
pivots.why: Expansion into home services, reason not stated in sources

outcome_analysis: Rezora IO is an active Fall 2026 company that began with outbound calling for real estate and added home services. It claims early revenue, but funding is not public. It enters a crowded voice agent market where Avoca and others raised large rounds, so differentiation and distribution decide whether it can grow.
notes: Commercial Observer says it launched officially on Jan. 12 (year 2026 per article date in the URL) and claimed 40K USD in 40 days, unverified. Founding year not stated in a source I opened, so null. The Caplight Rezora profile with 310K USD funding is a different Boulder company. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or lawsuit. The pivot entry is an expansion, not a stated pivot.
